p1_findings.title: GET /api/search route not wired — intentionally failing tests contaminating baseline
p1_findings.detail: FR-dependency-search requires a cross-entity search endpoint. Test file Source/Backend/tests/routes/search.test.ts explicitly documents it will FAIL until the route is implemented. This creates known baseline failures that violate the zero-regressions rule.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: CI pipeline reports test failures that are not regressions, masking real regressions. Developers learn to ignore failing tests, increasing defect escape rate.
p1_findings.impact: Test baseline corrupted; real regressions invisible; FR-dependency-search unimplemented.
p1_findings.recommendation: Either implement the /api/search route in Source/Backend (wire into app.ts, add handler), or formally defer FR-dependency-search and mark tests as test.skip with tracking comment.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (GHSA-3mfm-83xf-c92r)
p1_findings.detail: Handlebars.js has JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion by tampering @partial-block. Allows arbitrary JavaScript execution if attacker controls template partials.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: If backend uses Handlebars for any user-controlled template partial, attacker can inject malicious JavaScript that executes server-side.
p1_findings.impact: Remote code execution on backend server if Handlebars templates accept user input.
p1_findings.recommendation: Run 'npm audit fix' in Source/Backend. Verify backend does NOT use Handlebars for user-controlled templates. If it does, fix is urgent.
